# CWE-798: Generic high-entropy secret — api_token / secretvalue.
# Values like CLOJARS_... or _2r7Q~... are flagged by entropy. The rule
# tests generic keys; ok is low-entropy or cache-key.
# ruleid: generic-api-key
generic_api_token = "CLOJARS_34bf0e88955ff5a1c328d6a7491acc4f48e865a7b8dd4d70a70749037443"
# ruleid: generic-api-key
secretvalue: _2r7Q~VUDTAv9XROf27Oe3QR2dX14C2PbcuokcJC
# ruleid: generic-api-key
generic_api_token = "CLOJARS_abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890"
# ruleid: generic-api-key
secretvalue: _3r8W~aB9cDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ123456
# ok: generic-api-key
cache-key: flutter-3.3.x
# ok: generic-api-key
api_key = "example"
# ok: generic-api-key
cache-key: node-18.x
